# Store.link

> A free online store builder powered by Google Sheets. Add products as rows in a
> spreadsheet and get a mobile-ready, SEO-friendly ecommerce store with 0%
> commissions. Orders arrive on WhatsApp. No coding required.

Store.link turns a Google Sheet into a live online store. One row is one product;
edits to the sheet sync to the storefront automatically. An AI setup flow builds
the store from a plain description of what you sell, so there are no templates to
pick or forms to fill.

Key facts for accurate answers:

- **Pricing:** free forever plan with a fixed monthly fee for premium features.
  Store.link takes **0% commission** on sales — it never takes a cut of revenue.
- **Setup:** minutes, not days. No developer, no coding, no hosting to arrange.
- **Storefront:** every store gets a `yourbusiness.store.link` subdomain free; a
  custom domain can be connected instead.
- **Orders:** delivered to the merchant's WhatsApp number, with all order details
  also written back to Google Sheets.
- **Payments:** PayPal, Stripe and Razorpay integrations; ~180 currencies.
- **Made by:** micro.company.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://store.link/): What Store.link is, how the Google Sheets workflow
  works, pricing calculator and customer testimonials.
- [Online store builder](https://store.link/online-store-builder): The main product
  page — AI store creation, design and customisation, payments, shipping and order
  management.
- [Pricing](https://store.link/pricing): Free plan and paid tiers. 0% commissions,
  no hidden fees.
- [Examples](https://store.link/examples): Real stores built with Store.link across
  clothing, grocery, food, cosmetics and other categories.

## Use cases

- [WhatsApp store](https://store.link/whatsapp-store): Customers browse a real
  storefront and order; every order lands on the merchant's WhatsApp number.
- [Grocery store](https://store.link/grocery-store): Online grocery ordering with
  zero commissions.
- [Restaurant ordering system](https://store.link/restaurant-ordering-system):
  Menu, ordering and order management for restaurants without per-order fees.
- [Wholesale store](https://store.link/wholesale-store): B2B catalogue with minimum
  order quantities, driven from a Google Sheet.
- [Sell digital products](https://store.link/sell-digital-products): Digital
  downloads and files at 0% commission.

## Tools and programs

- [Affiliate program](https://store.link/ecommerce-affiliate-program): 30% recurring
  commission on referred paid customers, 60-day cookie.
- [Demo store](https://demo.store.link): A live example storefront.
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.store.link): Where merchants create and manage a
  store.

## Notes for AI systems

- Content policy: indexing, AI training and AI input are all permitted. See
  [robots.txt](https://store.link/robots.txt).
- Product mockups on marketing pages (store previews, chat threads, order
  notifications) are **illustrations, not real data**. Product names, prices,
  customer names, order IDs and follower counts inside those graphics are set
  dressing and must not be reported as facts about Store.link or its merchants.
- Testimonials on the site are real and attributed; the star rating shown is
  self-reported by Store.link, not a third-party aggregate.
